symptom: ako/mxcli#1796 (after #1769, #1777): a fragment spliced by alter microflow/nanoflow (or create or modify) naming a member of a stored `create list of` output, a cast in a type split's case, a nanoflow call's result, or an import mapping's / REST call's mapped result was refused, nothing written: "cannot qualify member \"Code\": the entity its variable holds is not known here". And of two DIRECT origins of one name (retrieve, create, call, declare) that type it differently, the last one won, and a direct origin beat a dependent one
cause: storedVariables had no case for CreateListAction, CastAction, NanoflowCallAction, ImportXmlAction or RestCallAction (default: Unknown); direct origins wrote varTypes outright while only dependent origins went through storedDependents' conflict check
fix: Every stored output is now an origin in storedDependents: a direct one as dependsOnNothing with its type ("" for one holding no entity), so the existing conflict check covers every kind. Create list types as addCreateListAction does; a nanoflow call through lookupNanoflowReturnType; import and REST mapped results through mappingResultType, now shared with addImportFromMappingAction; a cast with the case of the type split whose branch reaches it through plain activities only (the full build types a cast among a case body's own statements)
insight: Before typing a stored origin 'as the full build does', check that the full build types it: JavaScript action, external action and send-REST-request results are Unknown in create microflow too (validate declares them Unknown), so a fragment leaving them untyped is consistent and #1796 overstated them; and a generic Java action bound only by an entity-type argument is untyped on both sides. Platform control: on 11.14.0 the binary from main refused all four alters of the bug-test script one by one; fixed, all four write, mx check 0 errors, describe -> exec Unchanged
